title: MoE + expert parallelism
scope: One Qwen3-235B-A22B-shaped MoE forward · no attention · no FSDP

verification.label: Measured TorchTitan EP=4 MoE forward
verification.implementation: TorchTitan v0.2.0 ExpertParallel with functional all-to-all and torch._grouped_mm SwiGLU
verification.workload: Hidden 4096, 128 experts, top-8, expert intermediate 1536, batch 1 per rank, sequence 4096, BF16 synthetic activations
verification.measurement: 8.267 ms CUDA-event wall time; exact 8.036 ms rank-0 GPU kernel window shown
verification.timeline: Exact rank-0 kernel boundaries. The measured dynamic-split metadata wait is retained as fixed implementation context.

description: Start with the same local Qwen MoE path, but shard 128 experts across four GPUs. After source-side routing and permutation, dispatch sends token activations to expert-owning ranks; combine returns expert outputs to their source ranks before final weighted unpermutation.

Destination-local layout kernels are absorbed into the measured expert envelope rather than shown as conceptual stages. The visible sequence is exactly local MoE plus dispatch and combine communication.

TorchTitan v0.2.0 exchanges dynamic split counts and copies them to the CPU before dispatch. The measured wait is shown explicitly; it is not an inherent requirement of expert parallelism or a claim about every production EP implementation.

blocks.label: Router GEMM
blocks.description: Measured envelope from the router GEMM kernel to the first softmax/top-k kernel.

blocks.label: Softmax + top-k
blocks.description: Select and normalize eight expert assignments for every source-rank token.

blocks.label: Permute tokens by destination expert
blocks.description: Sort and gather routed token copies into destination-rank and expert order before network dispatch.

blocks.label: Fixed context: split-count exchange and host wait
blocks.description: TorchTitan v0.2.0 exchanges per-expert counts, waits for them, and copies dynamic input/output split sizes to CPU. This measured synchronization is implementation-specific.

blocks.label: EP dispatch all-to-all
blocks.description: Send each routed hidden vector to the rank that owns its selected expert.

blocks.label: Local grouped expert SwiGLU
blocks.description: Measured local-expert envelope: destination-local layout work, gate/up grouped GEMMs, SwiGLU activation, grouped down projection, and layout restoration for the 32 experts owned by this rank. Only the grouped expert computation is a portable conceptual stage.

blocks.label: EP combine all-to-all
blocks.description: Return expert outputs from expert-owning ranks to the ranks that originated the tokens.

blocks.label: Unpermute + weighted combine
blocks.description: Apply routing weights and scatter-add the eight returned expert contributions into original token order.
